title: Towards an integrative neuroscience of metacognition
title_zh: 走向元认知的综合性神经科学
abstract: Metacognition enables organisms to self-evaluate their own cognitive processes. In humans, this capacity underpins adaptive learning, social coordination and the formation of self-beliefs about skill and ability. A core motif that underpins multiple forms of metacognition is the ability to form estimates of performance in a self-directed frame of reference, expressed as propositional confidence about one's own behaviour and mental processes. Convergent behavioural, computational and neural evidence obtained across rodents, non-human primates and humans indicates that these self-evaluations arise from structured transformations of uncertainty. Dynamic evidence accumulation processes provide candidate building blocks for local confidence, whereas multimodal prefrontal brain areas integrate these signals to support abstract, global self-beliefs. This architecture supports metacognitive control at multiple timescales, from rapid error correction to strategic task arbitration and social communication. Dysfunctional metacognition can lead to disorders of reality monitoring and insight, in which erroneous mental representations are endorsed with aberrant confidence. By integrating computational, cross-species and clinical perspectives, metacognitive neuroscience offers a bridge from neural circuit mechanisms to subjective experience.
abstract_zh: 元认知使生物能够对自己的认知过程进行自我评估。在人类中，这一能力支撑着适应性学习、社会协调以及对技能和能力的自我信念形成。支撑多种元认知形式的核心主题是能够以自我为参照框架评估表现，表现为对自己行为和心理过程的命题性置信度。在啮齿类动物、非人类灵长类动物和人类中获得的行为、计算和神经证据表明，这些自我评估源于不确定性的有结构转化。动态证据积累过程为局部置信提供了候选构建块，而多模态前额叶大脑区域整合这些信号以支持抽象的全局自我信念。该架构在多个时间尺度上支持元认知控制，从快速错误纠正到战略任务调节和社会交流。功能障碍的元认知可能导致现实监控和洞察力障碍等疾病，即错误的心理表征被异常的置信度所认同。通过整合计算、跨物种和临床视角，元认知神经科学为从神经回路机制到主观体验提供了一座桥梁。
